findings.body:
**Account for the macOS job’s own timeout.**

The plan records `static-macos` with `timeout-minutes: 20` at `docs/w4-obligation-matrix.md:220,395`. GitHub cancels a job when its job timeout expires. A later `workflow_run` wake therefore cannot turn a run longer than 20 minutes into successful evidence. If the pilot needs more than 20 minutes, require a workload reduction or a job-timeout change before promotion; assess the legacy gate deadline separately. ([docs.github.com](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/reference/workflows-and-actions/workflow-syntax?s=09&utm_source=openai))
findings.title: Account for the macOS job’s own timeout.

findings.body:
**Paginate the sync PR list and add the named test I11 requires.**

The pull-request list at `policy/templates/sync-merge-queue.yml:155-156` is read without `--paginate`. The `api_as` helper (`:135`) runs `gh api -i` once and parses only that first response. The `existing` lookup that follows therefore sees only page 1. The `head` and `base` filters narrow this query, but I11 still requires REST lists to paginate: "REST lists paginate (`--paginate`, else truncated data)."

I11 also requires a named test beside each such call. No test in `test/` covers this list. `test/workflows/action-pins.test.ts:48` references the template only for pin checks.

Make the fix in `policy/templates/sync-merge-queue.yml`. `.github/workflows/sync-merge-queue.yml` is instantiated from that template, so regenerate it rather than editing it by hand.

- Fetch every page of the list request. `-i` prints a header block for each page, so split the response per page before you read the status and body. Keep the non-200 failure path.
- Add a named test in `test/workflows/` that asserts the list call passes `--paginate` and reads results beyond page 1. Follow the fake-`gh` pattern in `test/workflows/policy-provenance.cq-accept.test.ts:49`.
findings.title: Paginate the sync PR list and add the named test I11 requires.

findings.body:
**Reconcile the R2 contexts with the template before C2.**

S4 in `docs/w4-obligation-matrix.md:52` lists seven R2 contexts as declared today. Section 2.6 row 6 says the template "already lists `from-source` and `pack-audit`". The R2 `required_status_checks` in `policy/templates/github-settings.json` lists only `cq/acceptance` and `denylist`. Neither `from-source` nor `pack-audit` appears in R2.

Row 7b applies R2 "as templated" and removes the classic protection on `main` and `merge-queue`. The matrix records `from-source` and `pack-audit` as required on `merge-queue` today through S6. Applied as written, C2 would not carry those two requirements forward, although the matrix assumes they remain required. Correct S4 and row 6 to match the template. Alternatively, add the required contexts to the template in a reviewed change before C2.
findings.title: Reconcile the R2 contexts with the template before C2.
